title: Welcome to the page builder
seoDescription: A sample page created by the Stoned Goose Productions site scaffolding. Edit or delete me in Keystatic.

value.headline: Welcome.
value.italicLine: edit me, rename me, or delete me
value.subhead: This page is rendered from a block list in Keystatic. Open /keystatic, find Pages, and try adding, reordering, or removing sections.

value.heading: Pages, made of blocks.
value.body:
Every page in /keystatic is a list of blocks. Each block becomes one section on the page. You can pick from heroes, rich text, images, video embeds, call-to-action strips, mailing-list capture, and reusable blocks like the upcoming shows list or the latest social strip.

Reorder by dragging. Add by clicking the plus. Remove by clicking the trash. Save commits to GitHub and the site redeploys in a couple of minutes.

value.heading: Ready to build a real page?
value.subhead: Add a new entry under Pages in Keystatic. Set a slug like 'about' or 'faq' and start composing.
value.note: Tip. Add the page to the nav under Site config.
